verdict.rationale: Linear clearly lets users create issues (issueCreate mutation, pre-filled issue creation URLs) and assign them, with 'My Issues → Assigned' and assignedIssues in the SDK; the agent docs also show human assignees keep ownership when an issue is delegated to an app. Community users describe it as an issue tracker for capturing features and bugs. Due dates are never documented at the issue level; only project target dates appear. missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-issue due dates, a direct first-party description of assigning issues to human teammates, independent hands-on corroboration of the assign-with-due-date workflow.
